partial_evidence_found.title: Perancangan Sistem Informasi Medical Check Up Guna Mempercepat Pelayanan MCU di RSUD Brebes
partial_evidence_found.authors: Gunawan, I.; Agushybana, F.; Kartasurya, M.I.
partial_evidence_found.key_data: Manual MCU report processing at Brebes Regional Hospital took 3 days to 1 week to generate reports (quote: 'hasil pemeriksaan medis masih diproses secara manual, sehingga dapat diselesaikan dalam waktu 3 hari hingga 1 minggu'). Study involved 20 staff managing the MCU information system. Information quality weighted average score improved from 1.91 (pre-system) to 3.16 (post-system). No per-employee time or staff-hours-per-campaign figure provided.
partial_evidence_found.supports_claim: partially — confirms manual collation is a multi-day bottleneck but does not quantify staff-hours per 1,000-employee campaign
partial_evidence_found.limitation: Public hospital outpatient MCU context, not corporate multi-lab batch MCU. No per-employee hours figure. Single-hospital case study, not a benchmark study.

partial_evidence_found.category: primary — IDX-listed company annual report (PT Prodia Widyahusada Tbk, PRDA.JK)
partial_evidence_found.key_data: Prodia operates 152 clinics, 259 outlets in 67 regencies. 3,600 staff including >250 HIPERKES doctors and 1,200 paramedics. Corporate Client segment = 15.7% of revenue. Mentions 'turn around time and costs' minimization as key operational goal. No staff-hours or collation-time metrics disclosed.
partial_evidence_found.limitation: Annual report does not disclose operational MCU collation time, admin labor hours, or per-employee processing cost. Corporate client MCU volume not disclosed.

partial_evidence_found.key_data: Confirms IS implementation at Permata Cibubur Hospital accelerated MCU administration process and improved data accuracy. Study involved 30 informants (4 GPs, 1 specialist, 5 health staff, 5 MCU nurses, 5 management, 5 admin officers, 5 MCU patients). No quantitative before/after time data extractable (ResearchGate returned 403; abstract only accessible via search snippet).
partial_evidence_found.supports_claim: qualitatively — confirms manual MCU administration is a pain point requiring IS intervention, but no time/cost figures

partial_evidence_found.key_data: Human Health Services and Social Work Activities sector average monthly wage: IDR 3,415,963 (earlier period) rising to IDR 3,750,376 (later period). Source: BPS Indonesia. No breakdown for clerical/administrative sub-category.
partial_evidence_found.supports_claim: partially — provides salary anchor for health-sector admin workers in Indonesia (IDR 3.4–3.75M/month ≈ USD 210–235/month at IDR 16,000/USD), replacing JobStreet proxies

partial_evidence_found.key_data: Malaysia Clerical Support Workers mean monthly salary: MYR 2,931 (2024). Health and social work activities sector mean monthly salary: part of Services sector at MYR 3,831. Source confirmed via DOSM search result snippet (direct page returned SSL error).
partial_evidence_found.supports_claim: partially — provides Malaysia salary anchor for admin/clerical workers (MYR 2,931/month ≈ USD 665/month at MYR 4.4/USD), replacing Indeed/Glassdoor proxies

key_finding: No primary or secondary source provides a direct benchmark for staff-hours consumed in multi-lab MCU result collation per 1,000-employee corporate campaign. The 250–500 staff-hour range and the derived USD 445–1,395 cost model remain fully assumed. The closest evidence — the Brebes RSUD IS study (2020) — confirms manual MCU report generation takes 3 days to 1 week for a public hospital's batch, but does not give a per-employee or per-campaign hours figure. No government, multilateral, academic, or consultancy source for the specific claim was found after 15 searches across all priority categories.

suggested_revision_options.revised_claim_text: [ASSUMED-N]: Manual MCU multi-lab results collation consumes 250–500 staff-hours per 1,000-employee MCU campaign; direct labor cost USD 445–1,395 per campaign (Indonesia: IDR 3.4–3.75M/month admin wage per BPS; Malaysia: MYR 2,931/month per DOSM 2024). Operational time range is estimated from Brebes RSUD case (3 days to 1 week per batch) scaled to 1,000-employee campaign — no direct benchmark source exists. To validate: field interview with Prodia, BP Healthcare, or Fullerton Health operations teams.
suggested_revision_options.notes: Wage inputs can be upgraded from JobStreet to BPS (Indonesia) and DOSM (Malaysia) official sources. Time estimate remains unvalidated.

suggested_revision_options.revised_claim_text: Manual MCU multi-lab results collation is a documented multi-day bottleneck in Indonesian hospitals (3 days to 1 week per batch per Brebes RSUD, 2020). For corporate campaigns of 1,000 employees, administrative labor cost is estimated at USD 350–2,000 per campaign based on official wage benchmarks (BPS Indonesia: IDR 3.4–3.75M/month; DOSM Malaysia: MYR 2,931/month for clerical support workers, 2024) applied to an assumed 100–500 staff-hours — no validated time benchmark found.
suggested_revision_options.notes: Widens range to reflect genuine uncertainty; upgrades salary anchors to official government sources.

suggested_revision_options.rationale: If PP3.1 requires a defensible cost figure for investor materials, the 250–500 staff-hour range has no evidentiary basis and should be removed until field validation is obtained.

reasoning: The MCU collation time claim (250–500 staff-hours per 1,000 employees) is unverifiable through any public source. Evidence from Indonesian academic literature confirms that manual MCU report processing is a genuine multi-day bottleneck (Brebes RSUD: 3 days to 1 week per batch), providing qualitative support for the pain point but no quantifiable time benchmark. The wage components of the cost model can be partially upgraded from job-board proxies to official government statistics (BPS Indonesia, DOSM Malaysia). The specific staff-hour range requires primary field research — operator interviews with Prodia, BP Healthcare Malaysia, or Fullerton Health occupational health units would be the direct path to validation.
